notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Patch Notes - Update 0.34.6
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"]

Hello, Pebble Knights!

Thanks to your valuable feedback, we've made improvements to ensure a more stable and enjoyable experience in Pebble Knights.

Check out the details below!


New Features & Improvements

Merchant System Overhaul
The merchant has become more dynamic.

New entrance and exit animations have been added. The merchant now roams the map and sells items directly.

When the merchant appears, their location is marked on the bottom-right UI of the screen.
Weapon Improvements
"Hold to attack" is now maintained even after reloading ranged weapons.

Some weapons now have bonus critical hit chance:

High Heels, Stone Sword: +3%

Spear, Throwing Star, Reaper’s Scythe: +5%

Shuriken (Kunai), Karambit: +10%
Convenience & Accessibility
For streamers, all background music has been replaced with original tracks free from copyright issues.

A feature has been added to prevent photosensitive seizures:

 A flashing light warning is shown when the game starts, and a new 'Flash Protection Mode' is available in settings.
Optimization
 General performance has been improved to reduce in-game lag.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the merchant would occasionally not bring any items.

Fixed a bug where critical hit chance was unintentionally reduced in certain situations.

 Fixed rare cases where the host connection would drop or the game would crash.

We’re doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.

Thank you for all your support and feedback!

– Pebble Knights Team


For more news and updates, join us on Discord! 
https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy

notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Hotfix (250626)
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"]Hello, Pebble Knights!

 Thanks to your valuable feedback and gameplay data, we've rolled out a hotfix to address urgent balance adjustments and bug fixes.

 Your active reports played a big part in resolving many of these issues. Thank you again for your support!


Game Balance
Trait Changes
Sleep Paralysis: Now evolves faster.

Time to meet the evolution condition "Don't attack" has been reduced (70s → 50s)

Hug Me: You can now heal allies more effectively.

 Healing range increased (0.8 → 1.2)

Medic Kick: Now more viable for strategic use thanks to increased healing.

Healing amount increased (10 → 20)
Monster Changes
Rafflesia returns as a more overwhelming threat.

Its vines now have longer reach and attack range. If you fail to escape in time, you’ll be inflicted with Poison.

While caught in the vines, other monsters can still track and attack the player.

The number of Rafflesia units has been reduced.
Team Upgrade Changes
Vending Machine: Now provides more items, and more quickly.

Hits required to activate reduced (8~15 → 5~10)

Jackpot chance for extra item drops increased (5% → 10%)


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the text shown while struggling in a grabbed state displayed in the wrong language regardless of settings.

Fixed a bug where the Join or Create Room buttons would occasionally become unresponsive.

Fixed an issue where non-king players would sometimes not see the selection badge on the right side.

Fixed a bug where the "Body Slam" trait could trigger on already dead enemies.

Fixed some Angel and Devil room badges not functioning correctly.

Fixed a bug where the King could lift dead, invisible allies.

Fixed a pathing issue where players (including AIs) could block each other’s movement.

Thanks to your continued feedback, we were able to fix many bugs. 
Please keep the reports coming!



We’ll keep doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.



Thank you.

– The Pebble Knights Team


Join the community on Discord
https://discord.com/invite/hEuztrkbhy

New Features & Improvements

macOS Support
Pebble Knights is now playable on Mac!
Spread the word to friends who couldn’t join the fun before!
Gamepad Enhancements
We've optimized gamepad support based on your feedback.

Added a UI layout for PlayStation (PS) controllers.
Bug Fixes 
Gamepad – Fixed an issue where some settings and UI interactions couldn’t be controlled with a gamepad.

Fixed a bug where eating items or reviving teammates occasionally failed in certain environments.

Fixed character position issues in specific spots inside treasure rooms.

Fixed a bug where characters would move while dancing.

Fixed an issue where the King's trait evolution UI didn’t appear in certain situations.

Fixed a bug where text displayed in the wrong language after a timed event expired.

We’re doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.

Thank you for all your support and feedback!

notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Patch Notes - Update 0.34.4
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png"]

Hello, Pebble Knights!

We’ve added new features and improvements for a more enjoyable play experience.
Check out the details below!


New Features & Improvements

Traditional Chinese Added
Pebble Knights is gaining fame worldwide! Thank you so much for your warm support.

By popular demand, you can now enjoy Pebble Knights in Traditional Chinese.  


AI (Bot) Improvements
We’ve adjusted some AI (Bot) behavior patterns so they don’t interfere with player gameplay.  


Other Changes
A “Copy Room Code” feature has been added to help you share private room codes with friends faster.  


Game Balance Weapons 
Revolver: Increased magazine capacity (6 → 12) 

Military Boots: Damage increased (52 → 54)  
Monsters 
Giant Plant: HP increased (700 → 900)  
Others 
Treasure Room: Time limit extended (40 seconds → 50 seconds)  


Bug Fixes 
Fixed intermittent disconnection issues with hosts. 

Fixed certain texts appearing in the wrong language under some language settings. 

Fixed bug where some icons stayed the same even after changing control keys. 

Fixed missing weapon attack sounds. 

Fixed weird eating animation when consuming some weapons. 

Fixed bug where certain treasure chest items appeared suspiciously often under specific conditions. 

We’ll keep doing our best to make Pebble Knights even more fun.
Please continue to send us your feedback and support! 



Thank you, 

- Pebble Knights Team

notes.title: Pebble Knights Demo Patch Notes - Update 0.34.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229700/b3642c1542f78bbc750a269983cce3198e4fb05b.png

Hello, Pebble Knights!
We've added new features and made improvements for a better gameplay experience.
Check out the full details below!

New Features & Improvements

Tutorial Added

 Learn the rules and controls with the new tutorial. Great for first-time players.


AI(Bot) Improvements

 AI behavior has been refined to avoid interfering with player actions.


Other Changes

 Selected badges and traits are now clearly displayed on the Team Upgrade and Trait Evolution screens.
 The merchant NPC now has a stronger presence.
 The King can now swing a Pebble Knight and steal their weapon.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where ready item remained after leaving the lobby.
 Fixed a bug where the cursor overlapped some UI text.
 Fixed occasional disconnection issues with the host.
 Fixed inaccurate DPS readings in the lobby’s sandbag.
 Fixed a rare bug where nothing appeared during the King's trait evolution.


We're working hard to make Pebble Knights even more fun.
Thank you for your support and feedback!
– Pebble Knights Team
